summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a prospectus supplement for the resale of 2,793,294 common shares by certain stockholders. These shares were previously issued in connection with Ondas's acquisition of Mistral, Inc. The supplement was filed under Rule 424(b) to an effective S-3ASR shelf. No new issuance, buyback, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine registration-resale filing. No deal terms or strategic event are present. The filing is purely administrative and does not constitute a special situation.
